node.title: Re: Terminology: Is DBIx::Class an ORM?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I've always thought that since [mod://DBIx::Class] Maps an Object-oritented data structure to a Relational database, it's an ORM :-) Another way of looking at it, if I want to persist my OO classes to disk, an ORM is one way of doing that. In a quick skim of [wp://Object–relational impedance mismatch], it seems to mostly describe issues that would affect code that accesses the same database both via an ORM and without an ORM - that can indeed be a giant pain. But in regards to your question, I'd ask the other way around: why wouldn't [mod://DBIx::Class] be an ORM?
